questions.prompt: For convex f and normalized weights, Jensen gives:
options: f(sum lambda_i x_i) <= sum lambda_i f(x_i)
f(sum lambda_i x_i) >= sum lambda_i f(x_i)
questions.explanation: For convex f, f at the weighted mean lies below the weighted mean of f-values.
